status: Idle body/ocular controllers validated; reaction neutral-frame composition validated for seven presets and measured blink phases. Runtime integration and arbitrary-command behavior have separate gates.

source.sourceHashProvenance: Each preset's report.json pins the original binary source hashes

body.scope: Seven non-blue presets, neutral idle plus pointer events; not reaction/Computer activity
body.blue: No hover response in paired native data; separate rigid drag controller
body.coordinateSpace: Normalized original uncropped viewport, NOT fitted DOM cell
body.composition: B * Ry(dragYaw + gazeYaw) * Rx(dragPitch + gazePitch) * inverse(B), B = Ry(8 degrees)
body.pivot: Preserve paired idle body translation; custom rotation does not rotate the breathing translation about world origin
body.presentationOrder: Compare current hover state; advance spring by frame dt; process observed input events. Hover has one additional presentation latency relative to direct drag.
body.unchangedChannels: Every part: DrawBlock fields 32 onward, complete FrameBlock and SkinBlock are exactly equal to paired idle
body.claimLimit: Numeric body-transform agreement in this observation window, not whole-avatar pixel parity or proof for arbitrary input/activity

validatedInputs: Separate horizontal and vertical 60 Hz observations for all four ocular presets

eyes.profileDerivation: Anchor from exported deformationCenter; half-size from existing authored-parts eye-effect parser. Headphones dimensions differ between LODs and must not be shared.
eyes.composition: T(anchor + offsetXY) * projectedRotation * T(-anchor); postmultiply idle eye world, inverse-transpose the same correction for normals. Original depth/morph retained.
eyes.blink: Frog/Spectacles invert smoothstep morph half-channels; Coral linear closure multiplied by 6 before smoothstep; Headphones external scalar. Openness multiplies angular and translation response.

reactions.allSevenCore: All block fields, defines, and vertex attributes exactly equal paired no-input reaction during suppression core
reactions.headphonesModel: Superseded by the neutral-frame helper and hidden-blink contract above; older Headphones tests remain a discriminator for open-blink windows.
reactions.rejectedGeneralization: Applying weighted rigid gaze around current body pivot fails Frog/Coral/Spectacles by 2.5e-5..5.1e-5 in world elements. Fixed initial pivot still fails up to 2.1e-5. No approximate controller was integrated.
reactions.timingLimit: Observed direct public Character commands at nativeTime 2.5. Runtime clips were captured with native command 3 and have adapter presentation offsets. The measured 2.1-second core must be aligned to first post-command presentation, never by blindly subtracting from a runtime clip duration.
reactions.hiddenBlinkLimit: Headphones incoming/outgoing hidden blink now validated with an additional command at native3 during active blink. Long-term stochastic recurrence is still not inferred.

composition.scope: All seven presets at30Hz with horizontal gaze; Headphones60Hz with target reversal during core and a separate command during active blink
composition.breathingTranslation: Frozen incoming idle translation multiplied by suppression strength during entry; contemporaneous paired idle translation multiplied by release strength during exit. Reaction translation is not the pivot.
composition.body: T(neutralTranslation) * B * Ry(weightedYaw) * Rx(weightedPitch) * inverse(B) * T(-neutralTranslation)
composition.eyes: E=inverse(neutralFrame)*originalEyeWorld; postmultiply E^-1*C*E, where C is the authored projected gaze correction. Inverse-transpose the resulting linear correction for normals.
composition.unchanged: Every original DrawBlock field32 onward, FrameBlock, SkinBlock, defines and vertex attributes remain equal to paired no-input reaction
composition.remainingScope: Direct capture numerical agreement. Does not alone prove runtime source command-phase parity, arbitrary action interruption, or whole-avatar rendered pixel equivalence.

timingMetadata.proof: Detect first repeated breathing translation differing from contemporaneous idle. Headphones full entry/exit breathing envelope matches original translation within4.63e-11. headphonesHiddenBlink.formula: Entry closure = frozen incoming idle closure * suppression strength. Exit closure = live idle closure * release strength. Core gaze strength0.
